newsitem.title: USA: Clayton Williams to offer 1.25 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Clayton Williams to offer 1.25 mln shares.

text.p: Clayton Williams Energy Inc said Monday it has filed to offer 1.25 million shares of common stock.
Proceeds from the offering are to be used initially to reduce its bank indebtedness.
The company said it would then use its increased borrowing capacity, along with internally generated funds, to finance its 1997 capital expenditure program.

In addition, an estimated $5 million would be used to conduct and evaluate a 3-D seismic survey in search of Cotton Valley pinnacle reef formations on a portion of its updip block in the Giddings field in Robertson and Burleson Counties, Texas.
The company said it has granted the underwriters, Rodman & Renshaw Inc and Hanifen, Imhoff Inc, an option to purchase an additional 187,500 shares of common stock to cover an over-allotment.
